messages.text:
Hi Sarah,

I’m following up again on order Shop····.

This is the fourth miner I’ve purchased from HeliumDeploy, and I genuinely
love your products. I appreciate the $25 discount code you provided for the
delay and your offer to replace the NEXUS QX1 with the Hammer Miner Thor P2
(10 TH/s) at no additional charge. I accepted that offer on October 29.

On October 30, you explained that the swap was awaiting internal sign-off,
which you expected to be completed that morning, and that the replacement
would ship within two business days once approved. As of November 4, I
still haven’t received an updated order confirmation, shipping notice, or
tracking number.

I appreciate your efforts to make this right, and I’d really just like to
get the new miner up and running.

Could you please confirm whether the swap has been approved and processed,
and provide a firm shipping date and tracking information? If the approval
is still pending, I’d appreciate having it escalated so the miner can ship
as soon as possible.

I enjoy buying from HeliumDeploy and hope to continue doing so. I’m looking
forward to receiving the miner and putting it to work.

Thank you,
Robert H.
Handed to the team · order_swap.py preview refuses: team waiver covers up to $100, gap is $131.00. Fo

Hi Robert,

Thank you for being patient with this, and I'm sorry: the swap has not gone through yet. Your order Shop···· still shows the NEXUS QX1, so there is no updated confirmation or tracking to send you, and you were right to chase it.

Here is the honest position. The T. P2 you accepted is on the shelf at our US warehouse, so the unit itself is ready. What is holding it is the price difference between the QX1 and the Thor P2, which sits above what I can sign off myself. That sign-off is the only thing left, and you will not be asked to pay anything.

I have put it in front of the team with everything they need to approve it. They start at 10am ET today and this is on their list, so a colleague picks it up this morning. You will get the updated order confirmation by email as soon as it goes through, and the Thor P2 ships from our US warehouse within two business days of that, with tracking to this same address.

Thank you for sticking with us through four miners, Robert. I'm sorry this one has taken so much of your time.

Best regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
